metadata.environment: Chrome headless (patchright driver), Windows workstation, vite preview production build, CDP main-world instrumentation
metadata.note: Headless screenshots quantize the reflector to a visible moire pattern in BOTH baseline and candidate captures at 390 px; treated as a capture artifact, not a shipped-quality judgment. Relative same-state comparisons are valid.

mobile390.adaptiveDprProbe: backing=cssWidth (DPR 1.0) when candidate wired; baseline backing=487.5 (DPR 1.25)

mobile768.adaptiveDprProbe: backing=cssWidth (DPR 1.0) when candidate wired; baseline backing=960 (DPR 1.25)

screenshots.review: car, sponsor graphics, wheels, studio walls, controls all intact; no degradation vs baseline reference
controls intact; floor moire present — identical artifact in baseline capture
same floor moire artifact — confirms capture-related, not policy regression
intact controls, same moire artifact class

findings.moireAttribution: Present identically in baseline (DPR 1.25, reflector 512) and candidate (DPR 1, reflector 512) headless captures at 390 px. The 256 px reflector experiment showed the same class of artifact with zero additional frame-time gain at DPR 1, so the reflector downgrade was rejected.
findings.desktopQuality: Desktop path never altered by the policy (fine pointer = full quality); screenshots confirm no change.
findings.decision: No adaptive change shipped; DPR/reflector/shadows/materials remain exactly at the M3B.4.1 reviewed state.
